parsed.note_claim: Society has a term for a man who abandons his child: "deadbeat dad."
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The gender-specific deadbeat father and deadbeat mother are commonly used to refer to people who have parented a child and intentionally fail to pay child support
parsed.reason: The page confirms the existence and common usage of the gender-specific term deadbeat father for men who fail parental responsibilities.
